limitations: This review qualifies data preparation, not completed publication, training provenance, playing strength, search scaling or recipe selection.
Recheck launch pins and free space immediately before execution using reviewed supervisor; do not invoke unguarded mix command.
Timeout and cleanup use cooperative SIGTERM with reaping; no SIGKILL escalation. An uninterruptible or SIGTERM-ignoring owned process can exceed nominal timeout while supervisor retains its lock.
Non-policy copy/ordered schedule verification and completed target identity remain required before any training; publication alone is insufficient.
Audit uses FEN-only cached teacher inputs while training sidecars retain actual history. Negative SF-agreement result is descriptive.
Behavioral checks are author-run isolated process tests; reviewer independently inspected source and performed actual qualified-runtime import/parser checks.
